workflow_metadata.name: fetch_users
workflow_metadata.description: Fetch users and filter based on name

tasks.name: fetch_users
tasks.description: Fetches user data from JSONPlaceholder API via HTTP GET request
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to async HTTP activity using httpx.AsyncClient(). Configure appropriate timeouts for network operations. Activity should return response body for downstream processing. Add retry policy for transient network failures.

tasks.name: jq_filter_users
tasks.description: Filters user list to only include users whose name starts with 'C' using JQ transformation
tasks.temporal_translation_notes: Translate to Python activity that performs JSON filtering. The JQ expression '[.users[] | select(.name | test("^C"))]' should be implemented as Python list comprehension filtering users where name starts with 'C'. Can use standard Python JSON processing or pyjq library for complex JQ expressions. This is a pure data transformation suitable for a synchronous activity.

complexity_factors: Simple sequential workflow with only 2 tasks

data_flow.data_transformation_pattern: HTTP response body → JQ filter → workflow output

recommended_patterns.error_handling: Add RetryPolicy to fetch_users activity (network operations require retry logic for transient failures). Consider exponential backoff with 3-5 maximum attempts.
recommended_patterns.parallel_execution: Not applicable - sequential processing required (filter depends on fetch result)
recommended_patterns.loop_handling: Not applicable - no loops in this workflow
special_considerations: HTTP task requires httpx dependency for async HTTP operations
JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM task should be implemented as Python data filtering activity
Consider adding timeout configuration for the HTTP request (currently set to 0/unlimited)
The JQ expression can be simplified to Python: [user for user in users if user['name'].startswith('C')]
Output uses nested path ${fetch_users_ref.output.response.body} - ensure HTTP activity returns structured response object
Workflow has no input parameters - may want to parameterize the filter pattern or API endpoint
